text: dsh-spark-scope 是 DSH 网页端侧栏中的 Spark Scope 监控卡片。它在 DSH 主机读取已配置 Spark Scope 服务的状态，并在侧栏展示模型推理速率、请求队列、缓存和延迟，以及各节点的 GPU 负载、显存、温度与功耗；多模型服务的速率和请求数会汇总显示。设置页可填写服务的 HTTP 或 HTTPS 地址，卡片每两秒刷新并可折叠。使用前需要运行中的 Spark Scope 服务，并确保 DSH 主机能够访问该地址。

dsh-spark-scope adds a monitoring card to the DSH web sidebar. It reads a configured Spark Scope server and shows inference rates, request counts, cache, latency, and per-node GPU metrics. The card refreshes every two seconds and can be collapsed. Configure a reachable server address in Settings.
想在 DSH 侧栏随时看模型的 decode 和 prefill 速度。
需要查看推理服务正在处理多少请求、还有多少在排队。
有没有办法监控集群每台机器的 GPU 利用率和显存？
想在一个侧栏卡片里汇总多个模型服务器的推理速率。
Show me live decode and prefill rates from my inference servers in the DSH sidebar.
I want a quick view of GPU memory, load, temperature, and power for every node.
dsh-spark-scope 的功能「推理状态速览」：在 DSH 侧栏卡片展示模型名、节点在线情况、decode/prefill 速率和五分钟趋势，并列出运行与排队请求、缓存及延迟指标。卡片在页面可见时每两秒更新。
dsh-spark-scope 的功能「多节点与服务器监控」：侧栏逐节点显示 GPU 负载、内存、温度和功耗，并在多服务器场景汇总推理速率及请求数；缺少指标时按实际可用数据呈现。
dsh-spark-scope 的功能「地址设置与折叠」：在设置页填写 Spark Scope 地址，并可折叠侧栏卡片；折叠状态会保存在浏览器中。
dsh-spark-scope 会从 DSH 主机向设置的 Spark Scope 地址请求状态数据，以便显示推理与节点指标；该地址必须能从运行 DSH 的主机访问。

dsh-spark-scope README · dsh-spark-scope：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that puts the Glance view of the [Spark Scope](https://github.com/juliankang4/spark-scope) mini window in the left sidebar, so you can keep an eye on your DGX Spark nodes and their model server while you work. It works in both the browser (`dsh web`) and the Desktop app.
dsh-spark-scope README · dsh-spark-scope：

dsh-spark-scope README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-spark-scope
```

In the Desktop app, open Plugins, choose Add plugin, enter `dsh-spark-scope` and install it.

You also need a running Spark Scope server. See its [installation guide](https://github.com/juliankang4/spark-scope#installation).

dsh-spark-scope README · Set up：Open the Spark Scope tab in Settings, type your Spark Scope dashboard's address and press Enter. Both a local network address like `http://spark-scope.local:8787` and a tailnet address like `https://spark-scope.example.ts.net` work. If you leave out the scheme, `http://` is added for you. Clear the field to hide the card. If dsh does not let the page you opened save settings, the field is disabled with a note; dsh 0.2.0 allows it only on the computer that runs dsh.

dsh-spark-scope README · Set up：The data is fetched by dsh, not by your browser, so the address has to work from the computer that runs dsh. Spark Scope only answers requests made to localhost, an IP address or its own host name. To use any other name, such as a reverse proxy's, add it to `SPARK_SCOPE_ALLOWED_HOSTS` on the Spark Scope server.

dsh-spark-scope README · The card：The card sits at the bottom of the sidebar, above other footer items such as the dsh-cost-meter balance. The top of the card shows the model name, how many nodes are responding, and the decode and prefill rates with five-minute sparklines. Below that are running and queued requests, KV cache usage, TTFT and TPOT p95 for the last five minutes and the prefix cache hit rate, followed by a row for each node with its GPU temperature, power draw, load and GPU memory use. With more than four nodes, the rows fill two columns.

dsh-spark-scope README · The card：The card shows only the figures your inference engine reports, under the same labels Spark Scope uses. oMLX reports mean decode and prefill rates since the server started, so the card shows those without sparklines. llama.cpp reports mean decode time in place of TPOT and context use in place of KV cache. When Spark Scope needs an API key to read oMLX, the card says so.

dsh-spark-scope README · The card：If you run more than one model server, the card adds up their rates and requests, like Spark Scope's "All at once" view, and lists each server with its decode rate and state. A note such as "(servers 1/2)" means only some of the servers report that rate.

Memory on a discrete GPU is labeled VRAM. Mac nodes have no GPU temperature or power reading, so their rows leave them out, and the GPU power total says how many nodes it covers, for example "(5/6 nodes)".

dsh-spark-scope README · The card：The dot next to the model name is green when Spark Scope reports the cluster as healthy and orange for any other status. It turns red if Spark Scope stops responding or its data is more than 20 seconds old. A dash (`—`) means Spark Scope has no reading for that value.

dsh-spark-scope README · The card：The button in the top right corner collapses the card to a single line with the model name and decode rate, and your browser remembers the setting. The card is hidden while the sidebar is collapsed. It uses the dsh theme and language (English, Chinese, and Korean with [dsh-locale-ko](https://github.com/juliankang4/dsh-locale-ko)) and scales with [dsh-ui-scale](https://github.com/juliankang4/dsh-ui-scale).

dsh-spark-scope README · How it reads Spark Scope：The plugin adds a `/plugins/dsh-spark-scope/state` route to the dsh web server. While the page is visible, the card requests it every 2 seconds, and dsh fetches `<address>/api/state` with a 5-second timeout. The plugin only reads data and never changes anything on Spark Scope or the nodes. The route uses the same sign-in and Host checks as dsh's own API, so only a signed-in dsh page can read it. dsh ignores any Spark Scope response larger than 2 MB. See dsh's [SAFETY.md](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/SAFETY.md) for running dsh safely.

dsh-spark-scope README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | empty | Spark Scope address (`http` or `https`). Leave it empty to hide the card. |

The Spark Scope tab in Settings saves this value. You can also set it in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: spark-scope
  name: dsh-spark-scope
  config:
    url: http://spark-scope.local:8787

dsh-spark-scope README · Development：Use Node.js 24. Install dependencies with `npm ci`. Run `npm run check` for formatting, lint, JavaScript syntax and strict TypeScript checks. Run `npm test` to build and test the shipped bundle.

dsh-spark-scope README · Development：Type suppressions must use `@ts-expect-error: <reason>`. Inline lint suppressions must name one rule: `biome-ignore lint/<group>/<rule>: <reason>`. Blanket and file-wide lint suppressions are rejected. Non-null assertions remain allowed where TypeScript cannot follow an existing guard. The npm-generated lockfile is not reformatted.

dsh-spark-scope README · Development：Pull requests and pushes to `main` run the same check and test commands. The `CI passed` summary succeeds only when both jobs succeed; failed, cancelled and skipped jobs fail the summary.

Tested with dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 in Chrome and the macOS Desktop app, and with dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 in Chrome, using sample data in the state format of Spark Scope 0.1.4 and of the older 0.1.3.
